findings.section: THEORY.md, P1. Tensorized MES with genuine remainder propagation, opening premise and attribution after equation (P1); SCIENTIFIC_CONTRACT.md item 6

findings.counterexample_or_obstruction: In a geodesic, collisionless local regime with small q but unrestricted shear, the term -(10/7) STF(sigma q) in the cited quadrupole hierarchy is first order in q, not second order. findings.section: THEORY.md, J2. A data-law capability ladder, opening paragraph
findings.issue: The covariance-completion sentence should explicitly condition its Gaussian-region construction on an admitted jointly Gaussian law. Known covariance alone, and even Gaussian marginal distributions, do not imply the chi-square pivot used later in J2.
findings.counterexample_or_obstruction: Let Y=(Z,S Z), where Z is standard normal and S is an independent fair sign. Both marginals are standard normal and Cov(Y)=I, but Y^T Y=2 Z^2, which is not chi-square with two degrees of freedom. Its upper tail is heavier, so a chi-square-2 rejection region can exceed its nominal level. The contract's law-admission requirement and J2's later phrase exact Gaussian member already protect the intended implementation, which is why this is a clarification rather than a separate blocker.
findings.smallest_correction: Prefix the sentence with 'Under an admitted jointly Gaussian family'. Route covariance-only information to J2b and known Gaussian marginals without joint Gaussianity to J2a.

findings.section: THEORY.md, J3. Shared calibration is counted once, paragraph introducing equation (J3)
